manifest:
{
  "schema": 1,
  "id": "lumen.example.callout",
  "name": "Callout cards",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "description": "Renders ```callout code blocks as cards: the first line is the title, `- [ ]` lines become a checklist, [[links]] open notes.",
  "author": "Lumen",
  "license": "MIT",
  "main": "main.js",
  "capabilities": [
    { "id": "renderer", "reason": "Renders the `callout` code-block language" },
    { "id": "storage", "reason": "Remembers which checklist items you ticked" }
  ]
}
